{{Conjecture|legends}}

While working as a [[Landspeeder/Legends|landspeeder]] racer on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Boonta/Legends|Boonta]], the [[Triffian/Legends|Triffian]] [[Ebe E. Endocott/Legends|Ebe E. Endocott]] employed a '''personal clerk'''. When the clerk informed Endocott that the faster-paced sport of [[Podracing/Legends|Podracing]] offered higher purses for winning [[Podracer (profession)/Legends|pilots]], Endocott took up that sport.<ref name="The New Essential Guide to Characters">''[[The New Essential Guide to Characters]]''</ref>
